body.p: Claims 1-7, 9-11, 13, 14, and 16-20 will be pending after entry of the present paper. Claims 1- 15 were previously pending. Claims 1-9 and 11-14 are rejected. Claims 8, 12, and 15 are canceled without disclaimer of or prejudice to the subject matter contained therein. Claims 15-20 are new. Claims 1-4, 6, 7, 9-11, and 14 are amended as set forth above. No new matter is entered with these amendments. Applicant requests reconsideration of the present application in light of the foregoing amendments and following remarks.

The Office Action objects to claim 11 because of the following informalities: "the light source support" should be "a light source support". By this Reply, claim 11 is amended in accordance with the Examiner's suggestions. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests that the objections to the claims be reconsidered and withdrawn.

Claim 2-4 and 6 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112(b) or 35 U.S.C. 112 (pre-AIA), second paragraph, as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which the inventor or a joint inventor (or for applications subject to pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 112, the applicant), regards as the invention. By this Response, claims 2-4 and 6 are amended to address each of the issues identified by the Examiner. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests that the rejection of claims 2-4 and 6 be reconsidered and withdrawn.

Applicant appreciates the indication that claim 10 and 15 would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims. By this Response, claim 1 is amended to incorporate the indicated allowable subject matter of claim 10 and intervening claim 8, except that the feature "by between 200 and 30°" is omitted because Applicant believes this limitation is not necessary for reaching allowable subject matter since the feature combination of original claims 14 and 15, which was also deemed patentable, does not include said value range. Claims 11 is amended similarly. Claim 14 is amended to incorporate the indicated allowable subject matter of claim 15. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully submits that the

rejection of claims 1-9 and 11-14 under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over U.S. Patent Publication No. 2017/0073083 Al to Heimendahl ("Heimendahl") in view of U.S. Patent Publication No. 2023/0025975 Al to Feng et al. ("Feng") and further in view of U.S. Patent No. US 9209353 B2 to Radermacher ("Radermacher") has been overcome and claims 1-7, 9-11, 13, and 14 stand in condition for allowance.

In view of the above remarks, Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of all rejections. The Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned at the Examiner's convenience, if that would help further prosecution of the subject application. The Commissioner is authorized to charge any fees due, or any deficiency in the fee(s) filed or asserted to be filed, or which have been filed herewith or concerning any paper filed hereafter and which may be required under 35 C.F.R. §§ 1.16 - 1.18 (deficiency only) now or hereafter relative to this application and the resulting official document under 37 C.F.R. § 1.20 or credit any overpayments to Deposit Account No. 19-2814. This statement does not authorize to charge the issue fee.
